# CST Studio Suite

Electromagnetic Field Simulation Software

[Contact us][41]
[Visit a SIMULIA user community][42]

## What is CST Studio Suite?

CST Studio Suite® is a high-performance **3D EM analysis** software package for designing, analyzing
and optimizing electromagnetic (EM) components and systems.

Electromagnetic field solvers for applications across the EM spectrum are contained within a single
user interface in CST Studio Suite. The solvers can be coupled to perform hybrid simulations, giving
engineers the flexibility to analyze whole systems made up of multiple components in an efficient
and straightforward way. Co-design with other SIMULIA products allows EM simulation to be integrated
into the design flow and drives the development process from the earliest stages.

Common subjects of EM analysis include the performance and efficiency of [antennas][43] and
[filters][44], [electromagnetic compatibility and interference (EMC/EMI)][45], [exposure of the
human body to EM fields][46], electro-mechanical effects in [motors and generators][47], and thermal
effects in high-power devices.

## Why CST Studio Suite?

CST Studio Suite is used in leading technology and engineering companies around the world. It offers
considerable product to market advantages, facilitating shorter development cycles and reduced
costs. Simulation enables the use of virtual prototyping. Device performance can be optimized,
potential compliance issues identified and mitigated early in the design process, the number of
physical prototypes required can be reduced, and the risk of test failures and recalls minimized.

## FAQs About CST Studio Suite

### Is the CST Studio Suite free?

CST Studio Suite is a commercial program that is available through the Dassault Systèmes channels.
However, there is a free version: The [CST Studio Suite Learning Edition][53] introduces you to
electromagnetic simulation, simplifying the comprehension of Maxwell’s equations. This free edition
grants you access to our robust visualization engine and advanced solvers of CST Studio Suite, with
a few limitations. It is perfect for coursework and individuals aiming to enhance their proficiency
with CST software. 

### What is CST Microwave Studio?

CST Microwave Studio (CST MWS) was the first product of the CST Studio line of software. Initially
focussed on the finite integration technique (FIT) transient solver, it was well-suited for antenna
and wideband applications. It also included FIT-based Eigenmode and frequency domain solvers. Later
finite element method (FEM) and integral equation solvers followed. Finally, in 2006, CST Microwave
Studio and the other CST software were integrated into the CST Studio Suite.

### What are the Advantages of CST Studio Suite Software?

CST Studio Suite Software offers many advantages to the User.  First of all, there is the intuitive
user interface that simplifies typical modeling, post-processing and optimization tasks. Most
importantly, there is the set of solvers, that efficiently deals with simulation across the entire
electromagnetic spectrum, from statics to light. With the integration of CST  simulation software in
the **3D**EXPERIENCE platform new benefits or CST Studio Suite users unfold.

### What does CST Stand for in Simulation?

CST is the acronym for Computer Simulation Technology. CST was the company that developed and
marketed CST Studio Suite. It was acquired by Dassault Systèmes in 2016.

### What Is CST Software used for?

CST software is used for the simulation of electromagnetic fields across the entire
**electromagnetic spectrum**.  It allows engineers to experiment with virtual prototypes even at the
earliest stages of the design process, to compare the performance of different configurations, and
to optimize their products. Simulation can reduce the number of physical prototypes required and
shorten the development process, cutting both costs and time-to-market. Products can be simulated as
part of a realistic system to analyze their installed performance and verify they meet legal
electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and exposure limits, potentially avoiding time-consuming
redesigns or costly recalls.

### What Is the CST Studio Suite Learning Edition?

The CST Studio Suite Learning Edition is a software that helps you learn about electromagnetic
simulation and simplifies the understanding of Maxwell's equations. This edition is free and
provides access to the visualization engine and advanced solvers of the CST Studio Suite, with some
limitations. It is ideal for students and individuals who want to improve their skills with CST
software.

### What Are the Requirements for the Installation of CST Software?

Electromagnetic (EM) simulations fall under the category of high-performance computing tasks.
Therefore, computers utilized for CST applications need to meet stringent criteria concerning CPU,
RAM, and graphical specifications to attain peak performance. Up-to-date information can be found in
our [CST Studio Suite support area][54].

# CST Studio Suite

Electromagnetic Field Simulation Software

[Contact us][41]
[Visit a SIMULIA user community][42]

## What is CST Studio Suite?

CST Studio Suite® is a high-performance **3D EM analysis** software package for designing, analyzing
and optimizing electromagnetic (EM) components and systems.

Electromagnetic field solvers for applications across the EM spectrum are contained within a single
user interface in CST Studio Suite. The solvers can be coupled to perform hybrid simulations, giving
engineers the flexibility to analyze whole systems made up of multiple components in an efficient
and straightforward way. Co-design with other SIMULIA products allows EM simulation to be integrated
into the design flow and drives the development process from the earliest stages.

Common subjects of EM analysis include the performance and efficiency of [antennas][43] and
[filters][44], [electromagnetic compatibility and interference (EMC/EMI)][45], [exposure of the
human body to EM fields][46], electro-mechanical effects in [motors and generators][47], and thermal
effects in high-power devices.

## Why CST Studio Suite?

CST Studio Suite is used in leading technology and engineering companies around the world. It offers
considerable product to market advantages, facilitating shorter development cycles and reduced
costs. Simulation enables the use of virtual prototyping. Device performance can be optimized,
potential compliance issues identified and mitigated early in the design process, the number of
physical prototypes required can be reduced, and the risk of test failures and recalls minimized.

## What is CST Studio Suite?

CST Studio Suite® is a high-performance **3D EM analysis** software package for designing, analyzing
and optimizing electromagnetic (EM) components and systems.

Electromagnetic field solvers for applications across the EM spectrum are contained within a single
user interface in CST Studio Suite. The solvers can be coupled to perform hybrid simulations, giving
engineers the flexibility to analyze whole systems made up of multiple components in an efficient
and straightforward way. Co-design with other SIMULIA products allows EM simulation to be integrated
into the design flow and drives the development process from the earliest stages.

Common subjects of EM analysis include the performance and efficiency of [antennas][43] and
[filters][44], [electromagnetic compatibility and interference (EMC/EMI)][45], [exposure of the
human body to EM fields][46], electro-mechanical effects in [motors and generators][47], and thermal
effects in high-power devices.

## Why CST Studio Suite?

## FAQs About CST Studio Suite

### Is the CST Studio Suite free?

CST Studio Suite is a commercial program that is available through the Dassault Systèmes channels.
However, there is a free version: The [CST Studio Suite Learning Edition][53] introduces you to
electromagnetic simulation, simplifying the comprehension of Maxwell’s equations. This free edition
grants you access to our robust visualization engine and advanced solvers of CST Studio Suite, with
a few limitations. It is perfect for coursework and individuals aiming to enhance their proficiency
with CST software. 

### What is CST Microwave Studio?

CST Microwave Studio (CST MWS) was the first product of the CST Studio line of software. Initially
focussed on the finite integration technique (FIT) transient solver, it was well-suited for antenna
and wideband applications. It also included FIT-based Eigenmode and frequency domain solvers. Later
finite element method (FEM) and integral equation solvers followed. Finally, in 2006, CST Microwave
Studio and the other CST software were integrated into the CST Studio Suite.

### What are the Advantages of CST Studio Suite Software?

CST Studio Suite Software offers many advantages to the User.  First of all, there is the intuitive
user interface that simplifies typical modeling, post-processing and optimization tasks. Most
importantly, there is the set of solvers, that efficiently deals with simulation across the entire
electromagnetic spectrum, from statics to light. With the integration of CST  simulation software in
the **3D**EXPERIENCE platform new benefits or CST Studio Suite users unfold.

### What does CST Stand for in Simulation?

CST is the acronym for Computer Simulation Technology. CST was the company that developed and
marketed CST Studio Suite. It was acquired by Dassault Systèmes in 2016.

### What Is CST Software used for?

CST software is used for the simulation of electromagnetic fields across the entire
**electromagnetic spectrum**.  It allows engineers to experiment with virtual prototypes even at the
earliest stages of the design process, to compare the performance of different configurations, and
to optimize their products. Simulation can reduce the number of physical prototypes required and
shorten the development process, cutting both costs and time-to-market. Products can be simulated as
part of a realistic system to analyze their installed performance and verify they meet legal
electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and exposure limits, potentially avoiding time-consuming
redesigns or costly recalls.

### What Is the CST Studio Suite Learning Edition?

The CST Studio Suite Learning Edition is a software that helps you learn about electromagnetic
simulation and simplifies the understanding of Maxwell's equations. This edition is free and
provides access to the visualization engine and advanced solvers of the CST Studio Suite, with some
limitations. It is ideal for students and individuals who want to improve their skills with CST
software.

### What Are the Requirements for the Installation of CST Software?

Electromagnetic (EM) simulations fall under the category of high-performance computing tasks.
Therefore, computers utilized for CST applications need to meet stringent criteria concerning CPU,
RAM, and graphical specifications to attain peak performance. Up-to-date information can be found in
our [CST Studio Suite support area][54].

**Electronic Design Automation**

# Siemens EDA

Siemens EDA provides a comprehensive portfolio of electronic design automation (EDA) software,
hardware, and services for the design, verification and manufacturing of integrated circuits (ICs)
and electronic systems.

[Explore offerings][4]

### Enabling next generation Arm AGI CPU

Siemens hardware-assisted verification validates Arm AGI CPU for scalable agentic AI.

[Read more][5]

## The semiconductor and electronic systems industry faces a perfect storm:

Exponential complexity, geo-political volatility, skyrocketing costs and shrinking talent pools.
With software-defined, AI-powered, and silicon-enabled forces driving unprecedented change, the most
comprehensive digital twin technology transforms this crisis into competitive advantage.

### AI is everywhere

70% of chips will have AI acceleration by 2030 ([IBS Semi Market February 2025][6])

### Software-defined everything

Hardware is transitioning from fixed-function silicon into a flexible programmable platform.

### Moore’s law limits

We are scaling beyond Moore’s law to meet the demands of accelerating software workloads.

### Strategic reshoring

Reshoring semiconductor design and manufacturing competencies.

**2X**

### 2X Accelerating complexity:

Software demands are doubling every four months, outpacing Moore’s Law scaling.

**55%**

### 55% Increasing engineering effort

The engineering effort for AI chips has more than doubled, increasing from ~10,000 to ~24,000
engineering-months. ([IBS Global Semiconductor Industry Service, March 2026][7])

**120%**

### 120% Skyrocketing costs

The cost of advanced chip design has increased by over 120%, climbing from $245M to $539M ([IBS
Design Cost Report, AI, Chiplets, Sep 2024][8])

**1M**

### 1M Constrained talent-pool

We will see a global shortage of 1 million semiconductor workers by 2030 ([Deloitte, 2022, the
global semiconductor talent shortage][9]).

**trending technologies**

## Our strategic imperatives

We are pioneering EDA's future through purpose-built solutions that address today's trending
technologies and accelerate semiconductor and PCB design.

[
[siemens-fuse-eda-ai-agent-newsroom-01-1280x720]

### AI-first design methodology

We must embed context and domain-aware AI throughout the EDA workflow to shift from reactive to
predictive semiconductor design.

][10]
[
[3D IC ]

### 3D IC implementation

3D IC enables post-Moore's Law scaling through vertical chiplet integration while introducing new
challenges like thermal hotspots, multi-layer complexity, testing difficulties and design
verification bottlenecks.

][11]
[
[Digital twin of a car]

### Hardware-software co-design

Hardware, as an abstraction of software, requires shift-left simultaneous optimization before you
can commit to silicon, delivering superior performance and efficiency through unified design flows.

][12]
[
[Close-up of a computer chip on a circuit board with digital overlay graphics]

### Advanced-node readiness

Industry acceleration toward 3nm, 2nm and future nodes, demands advanced-node readiness spanning
tools, design methodologies and process expertise to navigate escalating complexity and cost
pressures.

][13]
[
[siemens-questa-one-agentic-ai-toolkit-newsroom-01-1280x720]

### Shift-left verification

Shift-left verification is a critical chip design strategy, with AI accelerating early defect
detection through intelligent pattern recognition, automated testing, yield prediction and optimized
coverage.

][14]
[
[ECA CPU brand evolution - hand holding microchip]

### Ecosystem integration

Ecosystem integration unifies design flows, leverages partnerships and streamlines foundry
collaboration to accelerate time-to-market and drive competitive advantage.

][15]

## Explore our EDA solutions

Learn more about our EDA products, solutions and services.

Featured Product

[Freezer spacers product image]

#### Plastic Freezer Spacers

Cut blast freezing time by up to 25% with Altium’s USA-made Standard and Maxi designs.
FDA-compliant, 100% recyclable, and trusted by food processors across meat, poultry, and cold
storage applications.

[Request a Quote][163]

## Your Market. Our Solutions.

We are committed to bringing our customers big design ideas and manufacturing excellence rooted in
creative innovation and branding know-how.

[Request a quote][164]
[

## Dairy

][165]

Whether you call them jugs, bottles, rounds, or containers, Altium Packaging is a leading producer
of standard and lightweight rigid plastic dairy bottles.

[

## Water

][166]

It’s clear to see that reliable containers are essential for efficiently transporting drinking water
and making brands stand out.

[

## Beverage

][167]

Consumer beverage preferences are constantly changing. We can provide packaging solutions that keep
you ahead of the curve.

[

## Food

][168]

People eat with their eyes first. The right packaging can make your product look as appetizing as it
tastes.

[

## Nutrition

][169]

From single-serve to bulk sizes, Altium Packaging has cutting-edge packaging to meet demands and
distinguish brands in the growing nutrition industry.

[

## Household Chemicals

][170]

Whether your product helps keep kitchen counters free from dangerous bacteria or windows sparkling,
our innovative rigid plastic packaging has got you covered.

[

## Specialty Chemicals

][171]

Greener grass or shinier surfaces, we design robust packaging with your product in mind.

[

## Automotive

][172]

If your product helps a car go, turn, or stop, chances are good we have the packaging solution.

[

## Personal Care

][173]

Altium Packaging creates packaging that cares for your product as much as your product cares for
consumers.

[

## Healthcare

][174]

Altium Healthcare’s complete line of containers and closures for prescription, over-the-counter, and
wellness products also feature safety protection for children and senior adults.

[

## Design Center

][175]
[

## Case Studies

][176]
[

## Product Catalog

][177]

## Our Network In The U.S. And Canada

At Altium Packaging, we are committed to ensuring our customers receive personalized service with
the dependability, flexibility and creativity our unique organization is known for. We achieve this
through our network of 65+ plants in the U.S. and Canada, 100 years of innovation, high quality
customer service, and nearly 4,000 dedicated employees.

## Forward Thinking

We design packaging solutions for beverage and consumer industrial products. It’s our job to help
your brand stand out and your business grow—and we take that responsibility seriously. The success
of your products and the future of your organization drive us to excel in our effort to be among the
leading plastic containers packaging suppliers in the world. Strong partnerships with those we serve
are what matters most to the Altium Packaging team.

[

## Why Altium

][178]

The leading customer-centric packaging solutions provider that helps elevate your brand.

[Learn More][179]
[

## Sustainability

][180]

Our sustainable solutions and practices drive value to our customers and protect the environment

[Learn More][181]
[

## What You Get When You Partner With Us

][182]

From the talented designers of Studio PKG™, to our experienced manufacturing teams across the
network, to our focus on environmental stewardship, Altium delivers. We pride ourselves on the
partnerships we’ve forged over the past two decades and will continue to deliver for you: High
performance packaging solutions. A cost-effective approach to meeting your needs. And the commitment
to sustainability practices that add even more value to you and your customers.

[Learn More][183]

### Packaging Solutions Always Made Right®

With a diverse stock bottle portfolio and an innovative design team working to produce creative
packaging solutions, we can help you find the perfect solution.

[Contact Us][184]

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

* Founded in 1986

#### About the COMSOL Product Suite

The COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} software brings a user interface and experience that is always the same,
regardless of engineering application and physics phenomena.

Add-on modules provide specialized functionality for electromagnetics, structural mechanics,
acoustics, fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical engineering. Choose from a list of LiveLink™
products to interface directly with CAD and other third-party software. Deploy simulation
applications with COMSOL Compiler™ and COMSOL Server™.

[Explore Product Suite ][38]
COMSOL Multiphysics^{®}

Create physics-based models and simulation applications with this software platform. The Model
Builder enables you to combine multiple physics in any order for simulations of real-world
phenomena. The Application Builder gives you the tools to build your own simulation apps. The Model
Manager is a modeling and simulation management tool.

[View COMSOL Multiphysics^{®} ][39]

Get to Know COMSOL

At COMSOL, we develop mathematical modeling software that drives new breakthroughs in physics and
engineering — and we love what we do.

Our mission is to provide easy-to-use software solutions to engineering problems and to help our
users get the most out of our products. We envision sustaining and reinforcing our position as a
leading provider and developer of mathematical modeling software. We also aim to make our technology
the primary tool for engineers, researchers, and lecturers within the fields of education and
high-tech product development.

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.

#### Sustainability

Humanity is now facing major social issues such as global warming and resource depletion. Under the
slogan of "Supporting the world with technology," the EBARA Group is working to solve a wide range
of social issues and contribute to the sustainable development of the earth and society through the
technological capabilities and passion it has cultivated over the years, as well as various
solutions.

[View Sustainability][198]

#### Innovation Story

Ebara was founded in 1912 as a venture company originating from a university. Since that time, in
order to meet the needs of society and customers, we have boldly taken on challenges in the spirit
of "passion and sincerity" even in unknown areas. This spirit of innovation has been inherited to
the present day, and we continue to provide new value to the world by sincerely responding to the
diversifying needs of our customers, contributing to the resolution of social issues.

[See the innovation story][199]
[ [YouTube video:Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World] ][200]

## Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

Generating a New Wave, Designing a New World

The EBARA Group has supported the ever-changing industry and social infrastructure, as well as the
evolving information society, with technologies that create the "flow" of water, air, electronics,
and energy. From now on, we will continue to create new "flows" that are needed in a changing world,
and create a better future full of rich smiles.

Kronegger’s mission is to assist customers in speeding up the development of NFC products. This is

Our products are designed for smooth integration and short product development cycles. In addition,

# What does it mean
# to achieve the unthinkable?

Complexity excites us. Collaboration drives us. At Lam, we relentlessly pursue innovation that
pushes the boundaries of technical limitations, creating solutions that enable chipmakers to power
progress.

 

No matter what innovation means to you, we won’t stop until it’s proven.

[ Explore Lam ][98]
[►][99]
[▐▐][100]

## Breakthrough isn’t just a product. It’s a process.

Making semiconductors is a highly complex and iterative process. And as technology gets smaller, we
think bigger meeting the challenges of precision control at the atomic scale. For every innovative
product you see, we’re already thinking… what’s next?

[View Products][101]

Your browser doesn’t support HTML5 video tag.

## Together we go further

Everyone at Lam is a deep listener, in tune with what customers, suppliers, and key stakeholders in
the entire ecosystem expect. And in turn, we’ve created an environment based on effective
communication, implicit trust, and past success.

# What does it mean
# to achieve the unthinkable?

Complexity excites us. Collaboration drives us. At Lam, we relentlessly pursue innovation that
pushes the boundaries of technical limitations, creating solutions that enable chipmakers to power
progress.

 

No matter what innovation means to you, we won’t stop until it’s proven.

[ Explore Lam ][98]
[►][99]
[▐▐][100]

## Breakthrough isn’t just a product. It’s a process.

Making semiconductors is a highly complex and iterative process. And as technology gets smaller, we
think bigger meeting the challenges of precision control at the atomic scale. For every innovative
product you see, we’re already thinking… what’s next?

[View Products][101]

Your browser doesn’t support HTML5 video tag.

## Together we go further

Everyone at Lam is a deep listener, in tune with what customers, suppliers, and key stakeholders in
the entire ecosystem expect. And in turn, we’ve created an environment based on effective
communication, implicit trust, and past success.

  Ampbox is a next-gen amp modeling platform that hosts our current* and future products.
  * [NEW! Ubersonic amp ][27]
  * [NEW! Spark amp ][28]
  * Powered by Mercuriall Neural Hybrid Engine v3.1
  * Free with the first purchase of one of the supported* products
  * Over a dozen of free modules (gate, pedals, EQs, tuner and more)
  * 2D cab based on Redwirez© IRs
  * Modern, simple, easy on the eye user interface
  * VST/AU/AAX + Standalone versions
  
  * Ampbox currently supports: Ubersonic/Spark/BST-7/SUN-100/Tweed Blues/Tweed
  Bass/1987X-SG/6160III/Rectofire/Euphoria/Reaxis/U530
* New era of ampsim modeling    [Details][29]
  
  Mercurial SS-11X officially models AMT SS-11 series tube preamps.
  * Modeling is officially certified by [AMT Electronics][30]
  * Next-gen modeling technology - Mercuriall Neural Hybrid Engine
  * Built-in OwnHammer cabinet IRs
  * Built-in custom cabinet IRs from private studios
  * Stunning tones with minimal tweaking
  * Most affordable Mercuriall product
  * Dead-simple user interface and tone shaping capabilities
  * Real-time monitoring without latency
  * Multi-threading CPU usage and stereo processing
  * Standalone version
  
   
* Amp ONE for iPad    [Details][31]
  
  iPad guitarists say: “Probably the best ampsim in the AppStore”. Amp ONE includes a set of preamps
  of some famous guitar tube heads with a set of the most important effects for making music. Allows
  you to perform live with the lowest possible latency. Simply plug your guitar and headphones or
  speakers.
  * Circuit-based preamp simulation
  * Highly customisable noise-gate
  * Cabinet modeling based on impulse responses
  * Four different stereo choruses, delay and reverb
  * AudioBus and InterApplicationAudio support
* Free Stuff    [Details][32]
  
  Guitar stomp boxes, preamps and cabinet simulation VST/AU/AAX developed for fun and modeling
  research.
  * Experimental nonlinear cabinet simulation
  * Stomp boxes based on circuit simulation, using the method of solving nonlinear differential
    equations.
  * Preamps simulations, using different neural networks approaches
  * Plugins available for Mac and PC (some plugins only for 32-bit DAWs, some old plugins only in
    VST format; experimental plugins not planned to be updated)

## An extension of our technical team

The AI Assistant has turned our support and distributor network into an extension of our technical
team. They can now respond to detailed product questions on their own, reducing turnaround time for
customers, and freeing up our engineering team.

Nick Drake

VP of Corporate Operations, Gullco International Ltd.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find quick answers to your questions here or reach out to us directly at [info@mfr.io][38] for any
additional information or clarifications.

How is MFR different from traditional manufacturing directories & on-demand platforms?

MFR stands out by providing real-time, high-fidelity manufacturer data and AI-driven matchmaking —
unlike directories that rely on outdated, pay-to-play listings or on-demand platforms focused only
on quick, transactional orders.

Our platform highlights manufacturers’ capabilities and product specifications in depth, fosters
direct relationships between buyers and suppliers, and prioritizes localized sourcing.

This emphasis on transparency, resilience, and long-term partnerships ensures that the right
manufacturer is matched with the right buyer based on real capabilities, not ad spend or speed
alone.

What types of manufacturers can join MFR?

We focus on industrial manufacturers of all sizes including custom manufacturers, component
manufacturers, and OEMs across North America.

Whether you specialize in CNC machining or have an extensive product catalog, our platform helps you
showcase your technical strengths and certifications (ISO, ITAR, FDA, etc.), making it easier for
the right buyers to discover and connect with your business.

If you're not a manufacturer, but your company specializes in bringing value to small to mid-sized
manufacturers, we want to hear from you as well.

How will MFR help me get more business?

Your AI Assistant, trained on your own data and preferences from your MFR.ID, streamlines early
buyer interactions on your website by automatically responding to repetitive questions, filtering
out unqualified inquiries, and guiding serious prospects toward submitting RFQs.

Meanwhile, your MFR.ID not only serves as an accurate, real-time digital representation of your
business, it also doubles as a powerful marketing tool that extends buyer reach organically and sets
the stage for future matchmaking tools and integrations.

This 24/7 support shortens the path to quoting, delivers more qualified leads, frees up your team’s
time for serious buyers, and builds trust by providing the transparent information they need to make
confident decisions.

Our factory’s at capacity, will MFR still benefit us?

Absolutely. Even if you’re not taking on new projects right now, you can set your profile to “At
Capacity.” This sets clear expectations for prospective buyers while still allowing them to evaluate
your capabilities.

When you’re ready for more work, simply switch to “Accepting Projects.” Any buyers who showed
interest will be automatically notified, so you never miss an opportunity. MFR keeps you visible,
maintains buyer relationships, and makes it easy to handle new business when the time is right.

What does the onboarding process look like?

It’s all done automatically using AI, so you avoid hours of manually gathering and curating data.

You begin by providing basic details such as machinery, product catalog, and target buyer profile.
Our AI agents then transform this information into an in-depth business and technical profile
highlighting the key areas that matter to your target buyers. You can update your profile anytime to
accurately reflect your shop’s strengths and unique offerings.

Once your MFR.ID is complete, you can activate the AI Assistant—either on your profile or embedded
on your website so visitors get real-time answers to their questions and are guided toward
submitting RFQs.

How much does MFR cost & how do I get started?

Creating your MFR.ID to show up in AI search results and receive RFQs is free for manufacturers. You
can also upgrade to a one-time **Capability Profile** for $299, which adds spec-based capability
pages, images, and an AI Knowledge Base.

For manufacturers who want an AI Assistant embedded on their website,** Integrated AI** starts at
$399/month (billed yearly). Pricing depends on how much data we need to connect and configure, with
larger catalogs or advanced workflows scoped accordingly.

For full pricing details and what’s included, see our [pricing page][39] or [request a demo][40].

## Let's Get You Started

Join manufacturers and buyers using spec-level data and AI to see real capabilities, get straight
answers, and connect directly. No pay-to-rank, no middlemen, no distractions.

## An extension of our technical team

The AI Assistant has turned our support and distributor network into an extension of our technical
team. They can now respond to detailed product questions on their own, reducing turnaround time for
customers, and freeing up our engineering team.

Nick Drake

VP of Corporate Operations, Gullco International Ltd.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find quick answers to your questions here or reach out to us directly at [info@mfr.io][38] for any
additional information or clarifications.

How is MFR different from traditional manufacturing directories & on-demand platforms?

MFR stands out by providing real-time, high-fidelity manufacturer data and AI-driven matchmaking —
unlike directories that rely on outdated, pay-to-play listings or on-demand platforms focused only
on quick, transactional orders.

Our platform highlights manufacturers’ capabilities and product specifications in depth, fosters
direct relationships between buyers and suppliers, and prioritizes localized sourcing.

This emphasis on transparency, resilience, and long-term partnerships ensures that the right
manufacturer is matched with the right buyer based on real capabilities, not ad spend or speed
alone.

What types of manufacturers can join MFR?

We focus on industrial manufacturers of all sizes including custom manufacturers, component
manufacturers, and OEMs across North America.

Whether you specialize in CNC machining or have an extensive product catalog, our platform helps you
showcase your technical strengths and certifications (ISO, ITAR, FDA, etc.), making it easier for
the right buyers to discover and connect with your business.

If you're not a manufacturer, but your company specializes in bringing value to small to mid-sized
manufacturers, we want to hear from you as well.

How will MFR help me get more business?

Your AI Assistant, trained on your own data and preferences from your MFR.ID, streamlines early
buyer interactions on your website by automatically responding to repetitive questions, filtering
out unqualified inquiries, and guiding serious prospects toward submitting RFQs.

Meanwhile, your MFR.ID not only serves as an accurate, real-time digital representation of your
business, it also doubles as a powerful marketing tool that extends buyer reach organically and sets
the stage for future matchmaking tools and integrations.

This 24/7 support shortens the path to quoting, delivers more qualified leads, frees up your team’s
time for serious buyers, and builds trust by providing the transparent information they need to make
confident decisions.

Our factory’s at capacity, will MFR still benefit us?

Absolutely. Even if you’re not taking on new projects right now, you can set your profile to “At
Capacity.” This sets clear expectations for prospective buyers while still allowing them to evaluate
your capabilities.

When you’re ready for more work, simply switch to “Accepting Projects.” Any buyers who showed
interest will be automatically notified, so you never miss an opportunity. MFR keeps you visible,
maintains buyer relationships, and makes it easy to handle new business when the time is right.

What does the onboarding process look like?

It’s all done automatically using AI, so you avoid hours of manually gathering and curating data.

You begin by providing basic details such as machinery, product catalog, and target buyer profile.
Our AI agents then transform this information into an in-depth business and technical profile
highlighting the key areas that matter to your target buyers. You can update your profile anytime to
accurately reflect your shop’s strengths and unique offerings.

Once your MFR.ID is complete, you can activate the AI Assistant—either on your profile or embedded
on your website so visitors get real-time answers to their questions and are guided toward
submitting RFQs.

How much does MFR cost & how do I get started?

Creating your MFR.ID to show up in AI search results and receive RFQs is free for manufacturers. You
can also upgrade to a one-time **Capability Profile** for $299, which adds spec-based capability
pages, images, and an AI Knowledge Base.

For manufacturers who want an AI Assistant embedded on their website,** Integrated AI** starts at
$399/month (billed yearly). Pricing depends on how much data we need to connect and configure, with
larger catalogs or advanced workflows scoped accordingly.

For full pricing details and what’s included, see our [pricing page][39] or [request a demo][40].

## Let's Get You Started

Join manufacturers and buyers using spec-level data and AI to see real capabilities, get straight
answers, and connect directly. No pay-to-rank, no middlemen, no distractions.

Our wide portfolio of leading-edge technologies is here to assist with unpatterned wafer quality, 3D
metrology spanning the chip from nanometer-scale transistors to large die interconnects, macro

lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging.

## Semiconductors Power the Modern World

Semiconductors enable the systems and products that we use to work, communicate, travel, entertain,
harness energy, treat illness, make new scientific discoveries, and more.

[Policy Agenda >][56]

[Map of Company Investments >][57]

[Map of U.S. Ecosystem >][58]

[Industry Fact Sheet >][59]

Video Credit: Intel

## Powering AI: The Semiconductor Ecosystem at the Foundation of Data Centers

Semiconductors are the foundation of artificial intelligence (AI), a technology that is transforming
our economy and society, making entire industries more productive and innovative, and driving major
scientific breakthroughs.

[Learn more >][60]

## 2025 State of the U.S. Semiconductor Industry

Semiconductors are a marvel of modern technology and the foundation of our digital world. The chips
powering modern smartphones contain more than 15 billion transistors, each smaller than a virus and
capable of switching on and off billions of times per second. The semiconductors at the heart of
today’s AI data centers can contain hundreds of billions of transistors, a number so high that if
you counted one transistor per second, it would take more than 6,000 years to count all the
transistors on a single chip.

[Learn more >][61]

## Semiconductor R&D Programs: Essential Innovation for U.S. Technology Leadership

To win the competition for technology leadership in industries enabled by semiconductors, such as
artificial intelligence, high performance computing, advanced communications, quantum, energy, and
defense—the U.S. must reaffirm itself as the epicenter of innovation for the semiconductor
industry’s newest technology paradigms. To this end, the U.S. is investing in high impact R&D
programs to secure the next generation of semiconductor innovation.

[Learn More >][62]

## Winning the Chip Race: American Semiconductor Innovation and Competitiveness under the Trump
## Administration & the 119th Congress

**“Winning the Chip Race” sets forth the U.S. semiconductor industry’s policy priorities for
collaboration with the Trump Administration and the 119th Congress. Policymakers should advance U.S.
semiconductor leadership through coordinated, complementary efforts to promote industry innovation
and competitiveness while also protecting economic and national security. **

[Learn more >][63]

## Emerging Resilience in the Semiconductor Supply Chain

The report projects the United States will triple its domestic semiconductor manufacturing capacity
from 2022—when the CHIPS and Science Act (CHIPS) was enacted—to 2032. The projected 203% growth is
the largest projected percent increase in the world over that time.

The study also projects the U.S. will grow its share of advanced logic (below 10nm) manufacturing to
28% of global capacity by 2032, up from 0% in 2022. Additionally, America is projected to capture
over one-quarter (28%) of total global capital expenditures (capex) from 2024-2032, ranking second
only to Taiwan (31%). In the absence of the CHIPS Act, the U.S. would have captured only 9% of
global capex by 2032, according to the report.

[Learn More >][64]

The U.S. semiconductor industry is the worldwide leader with half of global market share.

## Semiconductors Power the Modern World

Semiconductors enable the systems and products that we use to work, communicate, travel, entertain,
harness energy, treat illness, make new scientific discoveries, and more.

[Policy Agenda >][56]

[Map of Company Investments >][57]

[Map of U.S. Ecosystem >][58]

[Industry Fact Sheet >][59]

Video Credit: Intel

## Powering AI: The Semiconductor Ecosystem at the Foundation of Data Centers

Semiconductors are the foundation of artificial intelligence (AI), a technology that is transforming
our economy and society, making entire industries more productive and innovative, and driving major
scientific breakthroughs.

[Learn more >][60]

## 2025 State of the U.S. Semiconductor Industry

Semiconductors are a marvel of modern technology and the foundation of our digital world. The chips
powering modern smartphones contain more than 15 billion transistors, each smaller than a virus and
capable of switching on and off billions of times per second. The semiconductors at the heart of
today’s AI data centers can contain hundreds of billions of transistors, a number so high that if
you counted one transistor per second, it would take more than 6,000 years to count all the
transistors on a single chip.

[Learn more >][61]

## Semiconductor R&D Programs: Essential Innovation for U.S. Technology Leadership

To win the competition for technology leadership in industries enabled by semiconductors, such as
artificial intelligence, high performance computing, advanced communications, quantum, energy, and
defense—the U.S. must reaffirm itself as the epicenter of innovation for the semiconductor
industry’s newest technology paradigms. To this end, the U.S. is investing in high impact R&D
programs to secure the next generation of semiconductor innovation.

[Learn More >][62]

## Winning the Chip Race: American Semiconductor Innovation and Competitiveness under the Trump
## Administration & the 119th Congress

**“Winning the Chip Race” sets forth the U.S. semiconductor industry’s policy priorities for
collaboration with the Trump Administration and the 119th Congress. Policymakers should advance U.S.
semiconductor leadership through coordinated, complementary efforts to promote industry innovation
and competitiveness while also protecting economic and national security. **

[Learn more >][63]

## Emerging Resilience in the Semiconductor Supply Chain

The report projects the United States will triple its domestic semiconductor manufacturing capacity
from 2022—when the CHIPS and Science Act (CHIPS) was enacted—to 2032. The projected 203% growth is
the largest projected percent increase in the world over that time.

The study also projects the U.S. will grow its share of advanced logic (below 10nm) manufacturing to
28% of global capacity by 2032, up from 0% in 2022. Additionally, America is projected to capture
over one-quarter (28%) of total global capital expenditures (capex) from 2024-2032, ranking second
only to Taiwan (31%). In the absence of the CHIPS Act, the U.S. would have captured only 9% of
global capex by 2032, according to the report.

[Learn More >][64]

50.4%

The industry directly employs over 345,000 people in the U.S. and supports more than 2 million
additional U.S. jobs.
#6
Semiconductors are a top U.S. export after refined oil, crude oil, natural gas, civilian aircraft,
and automobiles.
1/5
The U.S. industry invests about one-fifth of revenue in R&D on average, among the most of any
sector.
